text: ふむ…　おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…　タイム　イズ　マネー…　…　ときは　かねなりか

structure.jp: おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…
structure.en: to not even have time to watch Teachy TV

structure.jp: タイム　イズ　マネー…
…　ときは　かねなりか

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A plain verb right before a noun describes that noun. おしえテレビを みる じかん = 'time to watch Teachy TV'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a sentence shows surprise or a comment about it. じかんも ないとは = 'to think you don't even have time…'.
